import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const b = await chromium.launch()
const errs = []
const W = Number(process.argv[2] || 1440), H = Number(process.argv[3] || 900), tag = process.argv[4] || 'desk'
const p = await b.newPage({ viewport: { width: W, height: H } })
p.on('console', (m) => m.type() === 'error' && errs.push(m.text()))
p.on('pageerror', (e) => errs.push('PAGEERROR ' + e.message))
p.on('requestfailed', (r) => errs.push('REQFAIL ' + r.url()))
await p.goto('http://localhost:4173/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
const total = await p.evaluate(() => document.body.scrollHeight)
let i = 0
for (let y = 0; y < total; y += H) {
  await p.evaluate((yy) => window.scrollTo(0, yy), y)
  await p.waitForTimeout(500)
  await p.screenshot({ path: `_scratch/${tag}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}.png` })
  i++
}
console.log('slices', i, 'height', total, errs.length ? errs.join('\n') : 'no errors')
await b.close()
EOF
